name: Absolute Monarchy
instantEffect: Lose 1 stability, gain 2 monarch power, and pick any Display Card from the discards
effect: Gain 1 stability each time you Enforce a Peace on an Opponent in a Peace Resolution

name: Benign Diplomats
effect: Whenever you place 3 or more influence at once during an Influence Action, place 1 influence extra for free. You may place up to 3 influence in each Area per Influence action, and also in Areas adjacent to any of your Ships.

name: Cannons
instantEffect: Gain 1 Artillery Unit in an existing Army
effect: Allows you to recruit Artillery Units in your Armies.

name: Bureaucracy
effect: During Phase 4, Step B: Gain 2 ducats extra, plus 1 ducat more for every full 10 ducats of Base Tax Income that you have.

name: Church Attendance Duty
effect: Increase Stability costs 1 diplomatic power less (applies to both the Basic Action and all card Actions).

name: Deus Vult
effect: Permanent Holy War CB against adjacent Distant Realms and Realms with a State Religion other than yours (except other Christian Realms if your PR is Christian). If at War with such a Realm, Mercenary Units cost 1 ducat less.

name: Colonization Policy
effect: The Colonize Action costs 1 diplomatic power or 1 colonist less.

name: Industrial Revolution
effect: At the end of Phase 2 (when all players have passed), take a free Trade Action, even using an activated Merchant, drawing from the top of the discard pile, or developing a Small Town into a Large Town for free.

name: Inquisition
instantEffect: If your State Religion is Catholic, gain 1 cardinal.
effect: The Convert Area Action and the Man of the Church card both cost 1 diplomatic power and 1 ducat less.

name: National Bank
instantEffect: Remove half of the loans from your Treasury.
effect: From now on, gain 8 ducats for each Loan taken, and pay 9 ducats to repay a Loan. Gain 1 loan fewer from Events than normal and none from Gold cards.

name: Scientific Revolution
effect: The Research Action costs 1 monarch power less. As a Minor Action, you may replace one of the unpicked Ideas on display with another Idea of your choice, at a cost of 1 diplomatic power. Requires: Have 2+ Ideas Researched.

name: Tolerance
effect: During Phase 3, Steps G and I: When adding unrest for Religious Dissent, add 2 fewer unrest than normal. Twice, immediately after rolling for an Area, you may re-roll one Rebel Die.

name: Cabinet
instantEffect: You may gain a Royal Marriage with an NPR that has the same State Religion as you.
effect: Add one more alliance token and one more royal marriage token to your Supply.

name: Constitutional Monarchy
instantEffect: You may pay 3 diplomatic power to gain 1 stability.
effect: At the start of Phase 3: Gain 1 diplomatic power if you are at Peace. Gain 1 stability as well if all Opponents adjacent to your Realm are at Peace too.

name: Efficient Spies
instantEffect: Take a Spy Network card from the discards into your hand.
effect: All Actions on the Spy Network card cost 1 diplomatic power less.

name: Free Trade
effect: Gain a third Merchant and place it in any Main Map Trade Node. You lose this Idea if you Research the "Mercantilism" Idea.

name: Mercantilism
effect: If you have 3+ trade power from Key Provinces when collecting Trade Income, gain 3 ducats extra, while Opponents gain 3 ducats less. You may not have more than 2 Merchants, and you lose this Idea if you Research the "Free Trade" Idea.

name: Pride and Glory
effect: You may place one claim per diplomatic power spent during a Fabricate Claim Action. You may place your claim adjacent to any Sea Zone on the Main Map where you are PR with the most Ships.

name: Quest for the New World
instantEffect: Gain 1 monarch power of your choice.
effect: You may use your Ships when performing the Explore Action.

name: Trade Companies
effect: When you collect Trade Income from a Trade Node on any Distant Continent, no Ship is required to trace a connection to your Capital Area through any non-Hostile Distant Sea Zone that is faced by 1+ of your Ports.

name: Shrewd Trade Practices
effect: Draw 4 Trade Cards (instead of 3) whenever you take a Trade Action.

name: Defensive Mentality
effect: For each Province you Own that is being Sieged, roll an Artillery Die. On an artillery result, the besieger suffers a Casualty, and you may then pay 1 military power to make the Siege fail.

name: Line Infantry
effect: Each Infantry+Hollow Infantry result on your Battle Dice now counts as 2 Infantry results. Each Infantry Unit may still only inflict 1 Casualty. Cancels the effect of "Tercios/Janissaries" (for both sides) in your Battles.

name: Glorious Arms
effect: Gain 2 resources each time you win a Land Battle where a PR Enemy participated with 3+ Units.

name: Serfdom
instantEffect: Gain +1 resource per Area where you Own all Provinces (max. 4).
effect: When taking a Replenish Manpower Action, gain the indicated resource instead of paying its cost. Refill 4 Exhausted units gained. During Phase 3, Step G, gain 1 extra resource per qualifying item in your Realm.

name: Mass Conscription
instantEffect: Refresh all manpower, gain 2 unrest, and lose "Serfdom" if you have it. Lose 1 stability unles you have "Revolutionary Regime".
effect: Refresh 6 Exhausted manpower per military power spent during a Replenish Manpower Action. You cannot Research "Serfdom".

name: Revolutionary Regime
instantEffect: Gain 2 military power. Set stability to -3 and set your State Religion to Revolutionary Ideology.
effect: Gain 1 stability whenever an Opponent Researches this Idea. At the start of Phase 3, lose 1 stability if not at War. During Phase 4, gain 2 military power extra. The research cost of this idea is modified by your current stability.

name: Tercios/Janissaries
effect: Each Infantry+Hollow Infantry result on your Battle Dice now counts as 2 Infantry results. Each Infantry Unit may still only inflict 1 Casualty.

name: Noble Knights
effect: At the end of Step 1 of the Battle Sequence, roll 1 Cavalry Die per Cavalry Unit you have and inflict 1 Casualty per Cavalry result rolled. Never roll more dice than the number of Enemy Infantry Units or 6 minus the number of Enemy Military Ideas. Your Regular Cavalry Units cost 4 ducats.

name: Military Drill
effect: When you fight a Land Battle, at the end of Step 1 of the Battle Sequence, remove one of your Enemy's Battle Dice from the Battle.
